name: Murasaki Izumiko
source: After changing her massive bear suit to the more compact one, Izumiko appeared to us as a small girl. Having the status of ambassador, she continues to live on Earth, so she still works at a part-time job, eats salmon rice balls and loves Jun'ichi.
